questions.question: Who are vegans according to the given passage?

options.text: who consumes vegetable, fruits and milk products.
who consumes honey, flesh and milk products.
who excludes every kind of animal products

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"who excludes every kind of animal product"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When you read the 1st line of the passage, you will find the following sentence:
 
 
• **Vegetarians who exclude animal products altogether (and likewise avoid animal-derived products such as leather, silk, honey, and wool) are known as vegans.**
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is: *who excludes every kind of animal product*

questions.question: Who are Lacto-vegetarians?

options.text: those who don't consume the sea foods
those who consumes milk products along with vegetables.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"those who consume milk products along with vegetables."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• When you read the 1st line of the passage, you will find the following sentence::
 
 
• Vegetarians who exclude animal products altogether (and likewise avoid animal-derived products such as leather, silk, honey, and wool) are known as vegans. ***Those who use milk products are sometimes called Lacto-vegetarians.***
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is *those who consume milk products along with vegetables.*

questions.question: According to the given passage who can be considered Lacto-ovo vegetarians?

options.text: those who eat flesh and sea foods
those who consumes milk as well as eggs
vegetarians who consume milk as well as eggs.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"those vegetarians who consume milk as well as eggs."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• When you read the **4th** line of the passage, you will find the following sentence::

 
 
• **Those who use milk products are sometimes called Lacto-vegetarians**, **and those who use eggs as well are called Lacto-ovo vegetarians.**
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is: those vegetarians who consume milk as well as eggs.

questions.question: When did the philosophy of abstaining from meat start?

options.text: in the middle of 2nd millennium BCE
in the middle of 1 millennium BCE
in the middle of 1 million AD
in the middle of 1 billion AD

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"in the middle of 1 millennium BCE"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• When you read the **8th line** of the passage, you will find the following sentence:

 
 
• Advocacy of a regular fleshless diet began about the middle of the **1st millennium BCE** in India and the eastern Mediterranean as part of the philosophical awakening of the time.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer: *in the middle of 1 millennium BCE*

questions.solution: The correct answer is **"Hindusim and Brahmanism"**

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of "Inflict"
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "Impose"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the selected word:
 
 
• **Inflict- **cause (something unpleasant or painful) to be suffered by someone or something, impose
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meanings of the rest of the options:
 
 
• **Explicit**- clearly expressed
 
• **Implicit**- not clear in meaning
 
• **Impose**- to cause something unpleasant
 
• **Huge**- large in size.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is: *impose*
